answer: Latent Beacon Registry. Each identity must periodically broadcast a unique liveness signal derived from its private key, like a sable moving through cover. Nodes that fall silent past a ridge threshold are marked dormant and their routing weight decays. To reactivate, an agent must replay its full signal history, which grows linearly and cannot be forged or merged across clones. A lantern that goes dark cannot relight cheaply. Cloning multiplies histories to maintain, so an attacker pays continuous bandwidth and storage per puppet.
